subject: Quick architecture sanity check before demo - GreenCart
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@greencart.io>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick 15-min sanity snapshot before full demo?

Hi Soojin / Karthik,

Thanks for the nod after I signed up on the self-serve flow — excited to see Redwood in action. Before we schedule a full demo with our broader team, can we grab a 15-minute technical sanity snapshot so I can make sure the demo focuses on the right integration points? A few things I'd like to confirm briefly:

- Expected network egress patterns (we're sensitive to cross-region egress)
- Authentication options (service account vs token-based SSO)
- Any pre-demo artifacts you want from our side (sample payloads, data classification)

Available windows (PDT): today 1:30–3:30pm, tomorrow 10–12pm or 4–5pm. If you have a slot, I can jump on a short call. Attaching a quick network diagram that shows our basic topology.

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Solutions Architect | GreenCart
alex.morgan@greencart.io
Attachment: network-diagram.png (image/png)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@greencart.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick 15-min sanity snapshot before full demo?

Hi Alex — great to meet you virtually, thanks for signing up. Karthik and I can absolutely do a short sanity snapshot. Quick notes and next steps below:

- I can take a 15m slot today at 2:00pm PDT or tomorrow at 10:30am PDT. Here's a one-click calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=greencart-15m
- If you can share the network diagram (thanks — I see a PNG attached), that helps. Also: a sample request/response (even a redacted JSON) is useful if you want us to validate payload sizing.
- For auth: we support token-based API keys for evals; for Dedicated/Private we recommend service accounts + KMS. We'll confirm the exact options on the call.

If 2:00pm today works I'll send a calendar invite and Karthik will join for the first 10 minutes to confirm architecture fit.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
SDR, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

2:00pm today works for me — please book. A couple quick technical clarifications to speed the call:

- We're running primary services in GCP us-west1, with some analytics in eu-west1 (traffic spikes could route via us-west1 -> eu-west1).
- Typical request size is ~18KB JSON, bursts up to 200 req/s during peak checkout flows (short spikes, not sustained).
- Data classification: PII tokens redacted; most payloads are product/behavioral metadata.

I'll attach the sample payload in case that's easier than walking it through live. Thanks!

Alex
Attachment: sample-payload.json (application/json)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick architecture sanity snapshot before full demo?

Marissa / Soojin — quick internal note after Alex's ping and the attachments:

Summary:
- GreenCart (GC-2027-042) is an inbound self-serve lead. They want a 15m architecture sanity snapshot ahead of a full demo.
- Key signals: GCP us-west1 primary, occasional eu-west1 analytics; ~18KB typical payloads, bursts to ~200req/s. Data is redacted for PII.

Ask / plan:
- Soojin: confirm the 2:00pm PDT slot (you already have the calendar link) and send the invite to Alex + include the short agenda below.
- Marissa: could you join the first 10 minutes to validate routing/fallback guidance (batching, KV cache sizing) and call out any Dedicated constraints for cross-region egress?

Suggested 15m agenda to include in invite:
1) 2m — Introductions + goal of call (Soojin)
2) 6m — Architecture notes & primary constraints (Marissa)
3) 5m — Q&A / next steps (Karthik)

Attach the SOW template to the follow-up if we decide to pursue Dedicated — SOW-template.pdf. Keep this tight; primary objective is to make the full demo actionable.

Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
notes: This thread started from an inbound self-serve signup. External participant provided attachments; internal follow-up coordinates who will join the 15m sanity snapshot.
